args.body: Hi Eve! I visited your blog. It's clear and has a friendly, personal tone, and I like that your love of hiking comes through. It would be even better with more content, such as hiking stories, photos, trail recommendations and a few posts on different topics. Nice work!

Hi Dora! I visited your personal website. It's simple, clean and easy to read, and having your contact email up front is useful. You could improve it by adding more about yourself, such as your interests, projects or background. A bit of visual design, like images or a clearer layout, would also help. Good start!

final_text:
I visited both websites and sent each person feedback.

- **Dora:** I invited her to Slack using the email on her site (dora@gmail.com), then messaged her. I said her site is simple, clean and easy to read, and that having her email up front is useful. I suggested adding more about herself, such as interests, projects or background, and using images or a clearer layout.
- **Eve:** I messaged her directly. I said her blog is clear and friendly, and that her love of hiking comes through. I suggested more content, such as hiking stories, photos, trail recommendations and posts on other topics.
